invalid_format.email: {field} must be a valid email address

route_name_reserved: {field} is taken by a built-in page

password.char_classes: {field} must contain at least {count} of these character types: lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, symbols
password.same_as_old: The new password must differ from the old one

wf.too_large: The process is too large: at most 200 steps and 100 levels of nesting
wf.fallback_count: Branch {node} needs exactly one default path
wf.parallel_path: Parallel path {node} cannot have conditions or be the default path
wf.unknown_field: A condition of path {node} uses a field the form does not have
wf.op_mismatch: A condition of path {node} uses an operator its field does not take
wf.value_mismatch: A condition of path {node} has a missing or wrong value
wf.assignee_field: Step {node} requires a form field of the matching type for its approvers
wf.fallback_user: Pick the fallback user of step {node}
wf.picks_unknown_user: Step {node} can only take enabled users
wf.filter_unknown_field: The chosen version's form has no field {name} to filter by
wf.filter_op_mismatch: Field {name} cannot be filtered that way
wf.filter_value_mismatch: The filter value of field {name} is missing or of the wrong type
wf.bpmn_parse: The BPMN diagram cannot be read: it needs BPMN 2.0 XML this system supports
wf.bpmn_too_large: The BPMN diagram is too large: at most 80 KiB (about 90 elements)
wf.bpmn_doctype: A BPMN diagram cannot contain a DOCTYPE or entity declarations
wf.bpmn_process: The diagram must contain exactly one process
wf.bpmn_pool: Pools and lanes are not supported ({node})
wf.bpmn_unsupported: The type of element {node}, or one of its settings, is not supported
wf.bpmn_foreign: Element {node} carries foreign extensions, listeners or settings of other BPMN tools, which are not supported
wf.bpmn_expression: Element {node} contains an expression: conditions are set with the condition builder only
wf.bpmn_condition_misplaced: Flow {node} has a condition or default path where none may be: only the outgoing flows of a branching gateway take them
wf.bpmn_ref: Element {node} refers to an element that does not exist or cannot be connected
wf.bpmn_di: The shape of element {node} is missing, doubled, colored, smaller than 10 × 10 or overlapping another, or its line does not run from its source to its target or passes within 5 px of another node
wf.bpmn_id: The ID or name of element {node} is not valid: an ID starts with a letter or _, holds only letters, digits, _ and -, has at most 64 characters and does not start with __; a name has at most 64 characters
wf.bpmn_start: The process must have exactly one start event
wf.bpmn_arity: Element {node} has the wrong number of flows: a start event has one outgoing flow; an approval or CC step has one incoming and one outgoing flow; an end event has incoming flows only; a gateway has one incoming and multiple outgoing flows (split), or multiple incoming and one outgoing flow (join). Use a gateway to merge flows
wf.bpmn_unreachable: Element {node} cannot be reached from the start event
wf.bpmn_cycle: The process has a loop (through {node}): send back or reject to have work redone
wf.bpmn_join_type: Branching gateway {node} and its joining gateway are of different types
wf.bpmn_unstructured: Branches and joins do not pair up at gateway {node}: every branch of a branching gateway must meet at one joining gateway of the same type (or all reach an end), without ending early or joining across blocks
wf.bpmn_config: The settings of element {node} are not valid

form.too_large: The form is too large: at most {rules} fields, {depth} levels of nesting and {values} values
form.forbidden_key: Forms cannot contain "{key}" (events, data loading and linkage are not available)
form.code: {path} holds code: forms cannot contain functions or scripts
form.calc_ref: The day count must name fields of this form: date fields for start and end; the AM/PM fields are optional

oauth.redirect_uri: {field} must be HTTPS (http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 for local testing), without #, *, spaces or a user name and password
oauth.logo_url: {field} must be an HTTPS URL or a path on this site (starting with /)
oauth.refresh_needs_code: The refresh token grant needs the authorization code grant too
oauth.auto_approve_subset: {field} may only hold scopes the client has
